name: Omarchy Help
author: modpunk
description: Help for Omarchy that acts, not just answers. Type to search your live keybindings, the omarchy CLI and the manual for your installed version, with no network and no model. Run a command in a floating terminal, open the manual at the matching section, or chat with the local GPU model about anything. When Omarchy can't do something, Build it hands the feature to Rix or your coding agent as a plugin or an omarchy.fans cloud web app.

barWidget.description: Bar button that opens Omarchy Help: search keybindings, commands and the manual; run, open, or chat.
